title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Sunday, 20 September 2026
description: Today: Google rolls out Home MCP for AI assistants as NVIDIA confirms its local-AI RTX Spark PCs; Canberra's Wright suburb demands a police station as Australia's first Indigenous eye surgeon is profiled; a Rockhampton bushfire is brought under control and Queensland's mining objection laws draw criticism; and the Gold Coast's runaway Tasmanian devil Mary returns to her enclosure. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
